text: The reports are produced by the engines from the database (R-001): progress_report gives the document S-curve, KPIs, discipline breakdown and late documents; engineering_plan gives the master document list, the AWP structure (CWA, CWP, EWP, PWP), the monthly load per discipline, EWP and PWP float and the coverage and benchmark checks; release_control gives the release plan, the relations, the impacts and the gate status (see ALP-EPC-00000-GE-PRC-0002 section 10); schedule gives the CPM schedule as Excel, HTML Gantt and MS Project XML for import into Primavera P6; document_register gives the register with the status of each document.
